options.name: action
options.description: The action the Firewall Filtering policy rule takes when packets match the rule

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: app_service_groups
options.description: Application service groups on which this rule is applied

options.name: app_services
options.description: Application services on which this rule is applied

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: departments
options.description: The departments to which the Firewall Filtering policy rule applies

options.name: description
options.description: Additional information about the rule

options.name: dest_addresses
options.description: List of destination IP addresses to which this rule will be applied. CIDR notation can be used for destination IP addresses.

options.name: dest_countries
options.description: Destination countries for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to specific destination countries. Provide a ISO3166 Alpha2 code.  visit the following site for reference U(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes)

options.name: dest_ip_categories
options.description: IP address categories of destination for which the DNAT rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to specific destination IP categories.

options.name: dest_ip_groups
options.description: User-defined destination IP address groups on which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific destination IP address group.

options.name: dest_ipv6_groups
options.description: Destination IPv6 address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IPv6 address group.

options.name: device_groups
options.description: Name-ID pairs of device groups for which the rule must be applied. This field is applicable for devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

options.name: device_trust_levels
options.description: List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. This field is applicable for devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your posture configurations. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

options.name: devices
options.description: Name-ID pairs of devices for which rule must be applied. Specifies devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

options.name: enable_full_logging
options.description: Aggregate The service groups together individual sessions based on  user, rule, network service, network application and records them periodically. Full The service logs all sessions of the rule individually, except HTTPS or HTTPS. Full logging on all other rules requires the Full Logging license. Only Block rules support full logging.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Determines whether the Firewall Filtering policy rule is enabled or disabled

options.name: exclude_src_countries
options.description: Indicates whether the countries specified in the sourceCountries field are included or excluded from the rule. A true value denotes that the specified source countries are excluded from the rule. A false value denotes that the rule is applied to the source countries if there is a match. Provide a ISO3166 Alpha2 code.  visit the following site for reference U(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes)

options.name: groups
options.description: The groups to which the Firewall Filtering policy rule applies

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier for the Firewall Filtering policy rule

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels that are applicable to the rule.

options.name: location_groups
options.description: The location groups to which the Firewall Filtering policy rule applies

options.name: locations
options.description: The locations to which the Firewall Filtering policy rule applies

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Firewall Filtering policy rule

options.name: nw_application_groups
options.description: User-defined network service application group on which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific network service application group.

options.name: nw_applications
options.description: User-defined network service applications on which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific network service application. Use Info Resource zia_cloud_applications_info to retrieve the list of applications

options.name: nw_service_groups
options.description: User-defined network service group on which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific network service group.

options.name: nw_services
options.description: User-defined network services on which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific network service.

options.name: order
options.description: Rule order number of the Firewall Filtering policy rule

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: rank
options.description: Admin rank of the Firewall Filtering policy rule

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: source_countries
options.description: The list of source countries that must be included or excluded from the rule based on the excludeSrcCountries field value. If no value is set, this field is ignored during policy evaluation and the rule is applied to all source countries. Provide a ISO3166 Alpha2 code.  visit the following site for reference U(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes)

options.name: src_ip_groups
options.description: User-defined source IP address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address group.

options.name: src_ips
options.description: User-defined source IP addresses for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address.

options.name: src_ipv6_groups
options.description: Source IPv6 address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IPv6 address group.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: time_windows
options.description: The time interval in which the Firewall Filtering policy rule applies

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: users
options.description: The users to which the Firewall Filtering policy rule applies

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: workload_groups
options.description: The list of preconfigured workload groups to which the policy must be applied.
